title: AffineEtaleFiniteDiagramDescent
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and c a limiting cone. Let v_i : FullAffineEtale(D_i) → FullAffineEtale(c.pt) and natural transformations q_i to the underlying-scheme functor satisfy the q-pullback squares over c_i [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site, def-pc-fibre-product]. For any n : N, target A, affine étale sources B_a indexed by Fin n, and arrows f_a : B_a → A over c.pt, there are a common stage i, affine étale objects Ai and Bi_a, arrows fi_a, and isomorphisms t : v_i(Ai) ≅ A and s_a : v_i(Bi_a) ≅ B_a, with v_i(fi_a) ≫ t.hom = s_a.hom ≫ f_a. No covering or surjectivity is assumed or concluded. The empty source family is allowed.

proof.text: Apply common object-model descent to Fin (n+1), whose zero object is A and successor objects are the B_a. Use the q-pullback square and each descended cartesian square to construct an isomorphism of schemes over the limit via their common canonical pullback, and lift it to FullAffineEtale.
Conjugate the finite family of arrows by the comparison isomorphisms and descend the resulting arrows to a common later stage.

Compose the later comparison isomorphisms with the original ones. Substitute the arrow-descent equations and cancel the target inverse followed by its hom. The associativity and isomorphism identities give the required displayed equations. The n=0 case still descends A because Fin (n+1) has its zero object.
